title: 第18章 格斗课上的变数
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周四下午，近身格斗课。

    安槐又翘了丹药常识来看训练馆，上次是站在走廊外面，这次他直接走了进去，在观战区找了个角落坐下。

    训练馆负责登记的助教看了他一眼。“你是来观摩的？”

    “对，想学习一下格斗技巧：”安槐笑了笑。

    助教翻了翻名单。“安槐？全年级综合第一那个？”

    “运气好。”

    助教点点头，没多问，让他在观战区坐下了。

    训练馆里今天人比上周多了几个，教官照例安排两人一组自由对练。

    安槐扫了一眼场上的分组名单，嘴角微微一动。

    苏念念的对手栏里写着一个名字。

    林落雪。

    巧得很。

    【格斗课分组采用教官随机指定。但根据我的检索，林落雪在课前主动跟教官说“想跟苏念念同学学习一下”，教官顺水推舟把她们分在了一起。随机这个词，在某些人手里意思是可控的随机。】

    安槐靠在墙上，目光落在场地中央。

    苏念念正在做热身，看到分组名单后扭头看了林落雪一眼，林落雪也在热身，动作标准但缓慢，像是特意在展示自己的生疏。

    教官一声令下，对练开始。

    苏念念走到林落雪面前，活动了一下手腕。“我轻点，你先来。”

    林落雪点了点头，怯生生地出了一拳。

    速度慢，力量弱，轨迹直白得像教科书上的示范图，苏念念轻松侧身躲开，伸手在她肩上拍了一下。

    “你重心太高了，压低一点。”

    林落雪按照她说的调整了一下，又出了一拳，这次好一些，但依然毫无威胁。

    苏念念耐着性子指点了两三招，出手力度控制得很好，每一下都点到即止。

    安槐在角落里看着，表情平静。

    目前为止一切正常，苏念念在教人的时候很有耐心，虽然嘴上不饶人，但手下分寸拿捏得住。

    第四轮试拳的时候，变化出现了。

    苏念念一个轻巧的推掌拍在林落雪的前臂上，力度跟前几次差不多，连皮肤都没压红。

    林落雪的身体却像被重击了一样，猛地往后退了三步，踉跄着差点摔倒。

    她捂着手臂，脸上闪过一丝痛苦的表情。

    “苏同学……好疼……”

    声音不大，但训练馆里安静的间隙，这句话刚好传进了周围好几个人耳朵里。

    几道目光齐刷刷地看向苏念念。

    苏念念愣住了。

    她清楚自己出手的力道，刚才那一掌别说伤人了，连训练服的褶皱都没压出来。

    “我没……”
content_en:
Thursday afternoon, close combat class.

An Huai turned his attention to the training hall again. Last time, he stood outside the corridor. This time, he walked directly in and found a corner in the viewing area to sit down.

The assistant coach in charge of registration at the training hall glanced at him."Are you here to observe?"

"Yes, I want to learn some fighting skills:" An Huai smiled.

The assistant coach flipped through the list."An Huai? The one who ranks first overall in the whole grade?"

"Good luck."

The assistant coach nodded and asked him to sit down in the viewing area without asking any questions.

There were a few more people in the training hall today than last week, and the instructor arranged for free sparring in pairs as usual.

An Huai glanced at the group list on the field, and the corner of his mouth moved slightly.

There was a name written in Su Niannian's opponent column.

Lin Luoxue.

What a coincidence.

[The fighting class groups are randomly designated by the instructor.But according to my search, Lin Luoxue took the initiative to tell the instructor before class, "I want to study with classmate Su Niannian," and the instructor took the initiative and put them together.The word random, in some people's hands, means controllable randomness.】

An Huai leaned against the wall and focused on the center of the field.

Su Niannian was warming up. After seeing the group list, she turned to look at Lin Luoxue. Lin Luoxue was also warming up. Her movements were standard but slow, as if she was deliberately showing off her unfamiliarity.

The instructor gave the order and the sparring began.

Su Niannian walked up to Lin Luoxue and moved her wrist."I'll be gentle, you go first."

Lin Luoxue nodded and punched timidly.

The speed was slow, the strength was weak, and the trajectory was as straightforward as a demonstration diagram in a textbook. Su Niannian easily dodged sideways and reached out to pat her on the shoulder.

"Your center of gravity is too high, lower it a little."

Lin Luoxue adjusted as she said and punched again. This time it was better, but still without any threat.

Su Niannian patiently gave instructions on two or three moves. She controlled the strength of her shots very well and hit the target every time.

An Huai watched from the corner with a calm expression.

So far, everything is normal. Su Niannian is very patient when teaching people. Although he is not lenient with his words, he is very measured in his hands.

During the fourth round of boxing trials, changes occurred.

Su Niannian slapped Lin Luoxue's forearm with a light push. The force was similar to the previous times, and the skin didn't even turn red.

Lin Luoxue's body seemed to have been hit hard, and she suddenly took three steps back, staggering and almost falling.

She covered her arms, a look of pain flashing across her face.

"Classmate Su...it hurts..."

The sound was not loud, but during the quiet moment in the training hall, these words reached the ears of several people around him.

Several eyes looked at Su Niannian.

Su Niannian was stunned.

She was aware of the force of her attack. Not to mention hurting someone, the palm she just struck didn't even break the wrinkles of her training uniform.

"I didn't..."
